title: Integral ambient internal Hom into a complete object is complete
statement: Let ell be prime, E/Q_ell a finite extension, and W a scheme. In the ambient derived category of modules over the specified completed integral coefficient sheaf [def-pur-integral-derived-operations], let M,N be arbitrary objects. If N is IsSfDerivedComplete [def-weil-derived-complete-integral-detailed], then the specified integralDerivedInternalHom(M,N) is IsSfDerivedComplete. No constructibility or perfectness assumption on M or on the internal Hom is imposed.

source.place: Lemma 3.4.11, internal Hom preserves completeness in its second variable; compare Stacks 08JB and 099B.

proof.text: For the actual unbounded internal Hom, characterize IsSfDerivedComplete by the Roos intrinsic local vanishing criterion. Restrict to AsSmall through the native ringed restriction equivalence. On the small site restrict to every slice; tensor-Hom currying and completeness of the second input make the nested Hom zero. The exact restriction comparison [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-internal-hom-exact-restriction] transports this zero object back, and the intrinsic/legacy equivalence recovers precisely the original completeness predicate, with the coefficient datum of [lem-a1-principal-koszul-strict-replacement]. This proves completeness of the specified ambient internal Hom without any constructibility hypothesis.

proof_origin.note: Extract the existing complete internal-Hom completeness proof and its three private helpers from IntegralOperationsScalarComparisons to satisfy the per-module compile limit. No new theorem hole.

from.place: Completeness of internal Hom required for the completed scalar Hom comparison

lean.statement:
theorem integralScalarInternalHomComplete (W : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.{u})
    (M N : DerivedCategory (integralTowerModules l E W))
    (hN : IsSfDerivedComplete l E W N) :
    IsSfDerivedComplete l E W ((integralDerivedInternalHom l E W).obj (op M, N))
